text: 国内物价温和回升；美联储加息板上钉钉？｜一周热点回顾 其他热点还有：进口增速连续6个月超过出口；七部门推动灵活就业人员参加职工医保。
text_en: Domestic prices pick up moderately; is a Fed rate hike set in stone? | Weekly hot spots review. Other hot spots include: import growth exceeds export growth for six consecutive months; seven departments promote flexible workers' participation in employee medical insurance.
